description: Family 10 (docs/tasks.md section 11): designing a single-oracle numeric DLC in which the offerer holds a fixed number of dollars. The protocol rules are dlcspecs' at the commit in provenance; every number below is a bench decision unless provenance says otherwise.

provenance.specification: dlcspecs at commit 9cd9148938c616690c79d99ec6f330e213c246c5 (2023-02-13), https://github.com/discreetlogcontracts/dlcspecs, vendored at vendor/dlcspecs: NumericOutcomeCompression.md (digit prefixes), NumericOutcome.md (rounding intervals, rounding to the nearest multiple with ties up, clamping to [0, total_collateral], CET calculation), PayoutCurve.md (the hyperbola piece for constant/outcome contracts), Oracle.md (an outcome above the maximum is attested as the maximum)
provenance.test_vectors: dlcspecs test/test_vectors/single_oracle_numerical_test.json (14 adaptor signatures) and single_oracle_numerical_hyperbola_test.json (56), reproduced in src/tasks/dlc/dlc.test.ts
provenance.num_digits: invented: 2^20 - 1 = $1,048,575 is at least 5.5 standard deviations of log price above every fixture's spot; Oracle.md's rule covers the rest; base 2 is the specification's recommendation (NumericOutcomeCompression.md)
provenance.rounding_mods: invented: powers of ten from 1 sat to 0.01 BTC
provenance.breakpoint_z: invented: interval beginnings at fixed quantiles of the forecast, so that the menu means the same thing on every seed
provenance.default_floor_ratio: invented: total collateral of twice the notional at spot, the floor policy's choice
provenance.cells: invented: volatility, tenor, the counterparty's annual cost of capital, and a price per CET in sats standing for the signing, verification, storage, and transmission each adaptor signature costs both parties; 1 sat for a server signer, 4 for a phone
